prerequisites: Successfully completed 1st and 2nd semester of the Master's program (see § 22 Section 1 SPO Part A Master)

learning_outcomes.text: After successful completion, students can independently work on a problem scientifically and methodically within a given deadline.
Students acquire the ability to present and analyze the state of the art and to apply methods learned in their studies to a scientific question.

syllabus_topics: Application of content from the Master's program
Independent processing of a practical problem or partial work from a team's field, with a clear indication of one's own contribution
assessment_rules: The Master's thesis will be graded based on its documentation. The duration for completing the thesis is 6 months.
bibliography: Arnemann, M.: Hinweise zur Anfertigung von Abschlussarbeiten und anderen Berichten, Stand 2022 (ILIAS)
institution: Hochschule Karlsruhe - Technik Und Wirtschaft — Maschinenbau (M.Sc.)
